document.title: PMK 92/2023: Mekanisme pelaksanaan dan pertanggungjawaban atas pajak ditanggung pemerintah

delta.note: PMK 92/2023 governs only budget execution, accounting, and accountability mechanisms for government-borne taxes (Pajak DTP). It covers the appointment of budget officials (KPA BUN), the issuance of SSP DTP, SPP, SPM and SP2D, and the accounting policies for subsidy expenditure and DTP revenue. It does not change any PPh 21 rate, threshold, deduction, facility, or calculation step for permanent employees. Under Pasal 3 ayat (2), the specific tax objects receiving DTP incentives are left to separate ministerial regulations. The document is purely administrative and budgetary.
